args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api began failing health checks. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status verified healthy with error rate ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to rollout.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated deployments**: checkout-api's history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release; v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging.
2. **Rolled back all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery**: service is now healthy across all regions with a low error rate (~0.2%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.
